## FOURFOLD community content submission

### What's included?
- [ ] Creature(s)
- [ ] New dimension
- [ ] Weapon(s)
- [ ] Vehicle(s)
- [ ] Quest(s)
- [ ] Expansion pack

### Checklist
- [ ] Added a JSON manifest under `marketplace/packs/`.
- [ ] Added a matching entry to `marketplace/catalog.json`.
- [ ] Checked IDs are unique and match the manifest.
- [ ] Manifest follows `marketplace/pack-schema.json`.
- [ ] Content is original or I have permission to redistribute it.
- [ ] Pack is data-only; no JavaScript, HTML or executable scripts are included.
- [ ] Tested import in FOURFOLD 0.6.
